QF.id: Cat III AIF Fees and Performance_1

question.text: Management fees of a Category III AIF are typically charged in the range of:

answer.text: A flat Rs. 25 lakh per annum

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 6.1.1, management fees are a fixed % of Gross NAV, ranging 1-2.5%, pre-specified in the PPM. **The Trap:** Rates below 1% or above 2.5% are atypical. A flat rupee amount is not standard practice. **Cross-Exam Context:** Mutual Fund schemes (V-A) are capped at lower rates under TER caps — Cat III allows higher fees reflecting complexity. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Confirm whether the quoted fee is inclusive or exclusive of GST when comparing products.
